# Flexge UI

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` and `src/design-system/README.md` before UI work.
The Flexge Design System in `src/design-system/` is mandatory for every screen
and prototype, including in clones and forks. Import shared components from
`@/src/design-system` and use the existing semantic `--ds-*` tokens. Extend the
shared core when needed; keep business logic in features. Follow the canonical
guide for stories, accessibility, validation and collaboration. Do not create a
parallel component library or override core component styling in features.
Follow `VERCEL.md` for publishing.
